Background

I'm an engineer drawn to problems that sit at the boundary of hardware and systems — where a well-designed experiment or a well-chosen model can change how a product is built, or how a policy is written. My work spans automotive cooling systems, advanced manufacturing, biomedical instrumentation, and emerging energy technology policy.

I care about precision — in measurements, in models, and in the arguments I make. Whether I'm running a wind tunnel test, fabricating MEMS sensors, or building a fixed-effects panel model, I try to understand what the data is actually telling me.
